text:
Items before the meal:
- Orange juice, about 200 g, roughly 90 kcal. All of it was drunk.
- Raisin toast, 2 slices, about 30 g each, roughly 160 kcal total. About 1.4 slices were eaten, with most of one slice and part of the second left.
- Cereal flakes, about 30 g, roughly 110 kcal. All eaten, with some milk left in the bowl.
- Blueberries, about 70 g, roughly 40 kcal. All eaten.
- Milk bottle, about 200 g, roughly 100 kcal. About 1/4 was left, so roughly 150 g was consumed, about 75 kcal. Some of the milk went on the cereal.
- Yogurt cup, about 100 g, roughly 90 kcal. Mostly eaten.
- Jam, about 15 g, roughly 35 kcal. About half the portion was eaten, so 15 kcal.
- Butter, about 7 g, roughly 50 kcal. Most was used, so about 40 kcal.
- Apricot spread, about 14 g, roughly 35 kcal. Eaten, so about 30 kcal.

I counted the toast as about 100 g total in the after photo, since the remaining piece looks like one slice with a bite taken out of it. That leaves about 1.3 slices eaten, roughly 40 g and 110 kcal.

Totals:
- Energy: 90 + 110 (toast) + 110 (cereal) + 40 + 75 + 80 (yogurt) + 15 + 40 + 30 = 590 kcal. Rounding down for items left uneaten gives about 580 kcal.
- Mass: 200 + 40 + 30 + 70 + 150 + 90 + 8 + 6 + 14 ≈ 608 g.
